title: Lentil salad with feta, carrot and parsley
steps: Cook the lentils in unsalted water for 20–25 minutes until just tender and drain.
Finely dice the carrot and celery and add them for the last 3 minutes.
Chop the shallot and whisk with the mustard, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper.
Toss the warm lentils and vegetables with the dressing, fold in the parsley and crumble the feta over.
